_what: How a person's posts are drafted, checked, approved and set to go at their time (read-data/posts.mjs). record_type is the kind of record a post is kept as; connection_type the kind of record a connection is kept as, whose id is connection_prefix + the connection id (encoded as a URL component). Every http(s) link in a post's words (the call to action carries its link there) and the post's own link get link_tags added, each a query parameter whose value is fixed (value) or taken from the post (from: post_id, platform or post_id_and_account_id, the post id and the destination's account id as post_id::account_id); link_joiner goes between the words and the post's link. utm_content is post_id::account_id, the destination's own token, because post-performance-attribution joins visits on it (an exact match, the bare post id still matches); utm_campaign carries the post id. ready_limits are the limits a place's format may set on a file (read-data/post-ready.mjs), each the limit name in a media kind, the file fact it is compared with, whether the fact must stay at_most or at_least the limit, its unit and its plain name; ready_words are the plain words for each finding. first_contact: a post can list people it contacts first in reaches, which names a person, public profile and where they were found. outcome_states turns each publisher outcome into the state a destination is in; resend_states are the states sent again by themselves (never one whose outcome is not known, which is resent only when the caller names it); outcome_words are the plain words for a failed destination, the first row matching its retry kind or a word in its code or message.

ready_words.not_connected: This account is no longer connected. Connect it again from Connections.
ready_words.needs_media: {platform} does not post words alone. Add a video or picture.
ready_words.media_gone: This post's video or picture is no longer in your files. Choose one that is.
ready_words.kind_not_taken: {platform} does not take this kind of file ({media_type}). It takes: {kinds}.
ready_words.takes_no_files: {platform} takes words only. Leave the video or picture out of the post for {platform}.
ready_words.type_not_taken: {platform} does not take this kind of {kind} file ({media_type}). It takes: {types}.
ready_words.too_many_characters: The words for {platform} are {count} characters; it takes at most {max}. Shorten the words for {platform}.
ready_words.setting_too_long: The {name} for {platform} is {count} characters; it takes at most {max}.
ready_words.not_known: Nobody gave the {kind}'s {fact_name}, so {platform}'s limit ({limit}) was not checked. Give media_facts to draft-a-post to have it checked.
ready_words.all_ready: Ready for every place it is going.
ready_words.connect_places: Pick where it goes: connect {platforms} in Connections, then choose it here.
ready_words.no_places: Pick where it goes: connect a place to post in Connections.
ready_words.file_not_checked: Whether the {kind} is still in the person's files was not checked here; check it is before the post goes.

words.reaches: reaches lists the people this post contacts first (at most {most}), each { network, handle, profile_url, provenance: [{ source, url, title, posted_at }] } with at least one place they were found.

outcome_words.says: {platform} needs you to sign in again. Ask your AI for the {platform} connect link, sign in, then publish again.
{platform} needs you to sign in again. Ask your AI for the {platform} connect link, sign in, then publish again.
{platform} is asking to slow down. Publish again later; the places that already have the post are not sent it again.
{platform} is asking to slow down. Publish again later; the places that already have the post are not sent it again.
The words are too long for {platform}. Shorten the caption for {platform} and publish again.

media._what: How a post's file reaches a place (read-data/send-a-post.mjs): from media_url, the address the caller made of it where the person keeps it. A place that fetches the file from an address (media_from address) is handed that address. A place that takes the bytes (media_from stream or whole) is streamed them from it. words are what is said when the file cannot be handed over: no_address when the post has a file and no address was given, gone when the address answers that the file is not there, unreachable when it could not answer.

words.no_address: This post has a video or picture, but no address of it was given, so nothing was sent to {platform}. Make a share of the file where you keep it and give it as media_url.
words.gone: This post's video or picture is no longer in your files, so nothing was sent to {platform}. Choose one that is.
words.unreachable: Your files could not hand {platform} the post's file right now ({code}), so nothing was sent. Send it again shortly.

at_its_time._what: How a post set to go at its time is sent then. The minute wake of workflow:send-each-post-at-its-time reads the due posts and hands each destination to tool:send-a-post, which sends only while the post still carries the armed_at it was set with and is in sends_while, so a post taken back, changed or set again sends nothing at the old time. words are its plain answers.

words.no_longer_set: This post is no longer set to go at that time, so nothing was sent.

reply._what: How a part of a thread is sent as a reply to the part before it (tool:send-a-post's reply_to, the platform post id of that part). platforms are the places whose publisher takes a reply target; any other place is refused before anything is sent. words are its plain answers.

words.unsupported: {platform} cannot take a reply to a post yet, so nothing was sent. Send this part as its own post.

markup._what: The markups a place may take a post's words in (read-data/publisher-requests.mjs inMarkup, named by a place row's {post: words, markup}). The words are read as Markdown into a post document (headings, paragraphs, lists, quotes, bold, italic, links); each node and mark is then wrapped in its row's opening and closing text ({level} is a heading's level, {href} a link's address), and each character in escape is written as its replacement. A node with no row is written as its contents. This is the wire format a place's API asks for, not anything shown on a screen.

waiting_words.says: {platform} has no credits left for this post, so it stays queued and goes when they return.

not_known_words: It is not known whether {platform} took the post. Look on {platform}; if it is not there, send it to this account again with resend: true.
